description: TypeScript typings for jsPlumb library, defining interfaces, classes, and method signatures for jsPlumbInstance and related types.

classes.name: jsPlumbInstance
classes.description: Interface defining the jsPlumb instance with methods for managing connections, endpoints, and rendering.

classes.name: JSPConnectionType
classes.description: Defines the connector type and styles for connections.

classes.name: PaintStyle
classes.description: Styling options for connection lines and overlays.

classes.name: Overlay
classes.description: Base interface for overlays like labels and arrows.

classes.name: ArrowOverlay
classes.description: Overlay representing an arrow on a connection.

classes.name: LabelOverlay
classes.description: Overlay representing a label on a connection.

classes.name: Connections
classes.description: Collection of connections with detach method.

classes.name: SourceOptions
classes.description: Options for making an element a source of connections.

classes.name: TargetOptions
classes.description: Options for making an element a target for connections.

methods.name: setRenderMode
methods.description: Sets the rendering mode (SVG, Canvas, VML).

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an event to a callback.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Executes callback when jsPlumb is ready.

methods.name: addClass
methods.description: Adds a class to an element.

methods.name: addEndpoint
methods.description: Adds an endpoint to an element.

methods.name: removeClass
methods.description: Removes a class from an element.

methods.name: hasClass
methods.description: Checks if an element has a class.

methods.name: makeSource
methods.description: Makes an element a source of connections.

methods.name: makeTarget
methods.description: Makes an element a target for connections.

methods.name: detachAllConnections
methods.description: Detaches all connections from an element.

methods.name: removeAllEndpoints
methods.description: Removes all endpoints from an element.

methods.name: deleteEndpoint
methods.description: Deletes an endpoint by uuid or endpoint object.

methods.name: getInstanceIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current instance.
